summary: Adds the deployment doctor (dlux_doctor) and a machine-readable stack contract for Composer's check, drops the redundant db-backup and pgadmin services, and fixes several inline-update issues (version-mismatched static, preflight aborts, and frozen progress).
highlights: New dlux_doctor deployment doctor (settings, DB, migrations, services, static, security) with a --format json report that Composer's check --deep consumes; dlux_check is a deprecated alias.
New dlux_stack_contract command and stack_contract.json spec so Composer's check can flag network-topology drift and removed services.
Dropped the db-backup service (superseded by DjangoLux system backups) and pgadmin from the default stack.
Every compose service now carries an org.dlux.restart safe/protected label for restart classification.
Fixed stale/version-mismatched static after an inline update, an inline-update preflight abort, and the progress modal freezing during maintenance.
